caption: After a Preview submission the template result screen still shows its sample numbers: Your cost $4000, Your savings $2000, Your ROI $3000.

Analyze right after the Preview response: 'Waiting for responses! This calculator does not have any traffic yet', so Preview answers are not stored; the calculator name and account initial are hidden.
Subscription during the trial: Business (Monthly), plan price USD 720, 0 / 100 leads this period, expires Nov 6th 2026; the account initial is hidden.
Add New User offers four roles, Admin, Manager (preselected), Designer and Analyst, and no view-only role; the account initial is hidden.
After Go Live, 'Receive an email when someone uses your Calculator' is switched on by default; the share link, calculator name and account initial are hidden.
Reopening the published form in the same browser: the lead form comes back filled with the previous respondent's name, test ID and code; the email address is hidden.
The Full Export appears under Previous Reports (30/10/2026, 1:46 PM) with a report link, next to the email delivery; the calculator name and account initial are hidden.
The menu on the live calculator card offers Copy Link, Edit, Analytics, Settings, Duplicate, Move and Delete, but no unpublish; the calculator name is hidden.
